info.name: Mudnaan ERP API
info.description:
Complete QA collection for the Mudnaan ERP backend (CodeIgniter 4, JWT, tenant-per-database).

HOW TO RUN
1. Import this collection AND the environment file, select the 'Mudnaan ERP — Local' environment.
2. Run 'Authentication → Login (Owner)' once — every other request then authenticates automatically via {{token}}.
3. Or run the WHOLE collection with the Collection Runner: folders are ordered so created resources feed later requests (category → product → customer/supplier → purchase/sale → documents → accounting).

NOTES
- Demo tenant is PREMIUM, so premium routes return 200. On a basic tenant they return 403 PLAN_UPGRADE_REQUIRED.
- Financial periods have unique date ranges: the second full run gets PERIOD_OVERLAP on 'Create period' (correct behavior) — delete the April 2026 period or change its dates to re-run.
- Staff user management endpoints are not in the API yet.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Login stores the JWT in {{token}} automatically; every other request uses it via collection-level bearer auth. Demo users: yasir@demo.com (Owner, all permissions) and cashier@demo.com (Cashier, POS-level permissions), both password Secret123!.

request.description: Public. Returns token + user + plan + permissions. Stores {{token}} for the whole collection.

exec: // 'data' is reserved in the Postman sandbox — use another name.

Expected error case: INVALID_CREDENTIALS.
Validation failure: identity and password required.
Requires a valid token. Returns user + plan + permissions.
Expected error case: UNAUTHORIZED.

Stateless: client discards the token afterwards. (The collection keeps using {{token}}, which stays valid.)

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Home-screen KPIs. Permission: reports.basic (all roles, all plans).

request.description: today {total_sales, net_profit, transactions}, stock alerts, pending purchases, recent sales, 7-day curve.

item.name: Categories
item.description: Product grouping. Permissions: products.view / products.create.

request.description: Stores {{category_id}} for the product create below.

item.name: Products
item.description: Catalog with per-branch stock. Permissions: products.view/create/edit/delete.

request.description: Returns items + meta {page, per_page, total, total_pages}.
opening_stock writes an 'opening' ledger row so the product is sellable immediately. Stores {{product_id}}.
Partial update — only sent fields change.
Missing name + negative price.

item.name: Inventory — Stock
item.description: The stock ledger AND its accounting. Every manual adjustment posts at cost to the books (Inventory <-> Inventory Adjustment 5100), so stock_value and book_value stay reconciled. Opening stock on a new product posts Inventory / Owner's Capital. Permissions: stock.view / stock.adjust.

request.description: summary {total_units, stock_value, book_value (the Inventory GL balance, Premium), low_stock, out_of_stock} + per-product levels.
Each row carries cost_value (|qty| × cost price).
Writes a +5 ledger row and, on Premium, posts value at cost: DEBIT Inventory / CREDIT Inventory Adjustment. Returns {product, value}.
Negative adjustment posts DEBIT Inventory Adjustment / CREDIT Inventory — a stock loss on the P&L.
After the adjustments, book_value should still equal stock_value (inventory and the ledger stay in step).
Guard: stock can never go negative.

item.name: Customers
item.description: The tenant's shoppers. balance: + store credit / - owes us. Permissions: customers.view / customers.manage.

request.description: Stores {{customer_id}} — used by sales, invoices, receipts and deposits below.

item.name: Suppliers
item.description: Who the tenant buys from. Permissions: suppliers.view / suppliers.manage.

request.description: Stores {{supplier_id}} — used by purchases and bills.

item.name: Purchases
item.description: Goods received — ADDS stock (+qty ledger rows). A purchase that isn't fully paid auto-creates a linked supplier bill. Premium tenants also get the journal posting (Inventory / Cash + Accounts Payable). Permissions: purchases.view / purchases.create.

request.description: Total 25.00, pays 20.00 → a supplier bill for the outstanding 5.00 appears in Supplier Bills. Stores {{purchase_id}}.

item.name: Sales / POS
item.description: The POS flow. Totals are always recomputed server-side; a client uuid makes creation idempotent (offline-ready); credit sales require a customer and auto-create a customer invoice. Permissions: sales.view / sales.create.

request.description: 2 × 1.10 = 2.20 fully paid → status completed. Stock -2. Premium: auto journal entry. Stores {{sale_id}}.
Pays 5.00 of 11.00 → status partial, customer owes 6.00, a customer invoice is auto-created (see Customer Invoices).
Header + line items + payments.

item.name: Customer Invoices
item.description: Accounts receivable documents. Standalone invoices move stock and (Premium) post AR / Revenue / COGS; sale-linked ones are created automatically by partial POS sales and never double-post. Permissions: invoices.view / invoices.manage.

request.description: Product line checks + moves stock; the free-text line is a service. Stores {{invoice_id}}.

item.name: Customer Receipts
item.description: Money in from customers. Settles an invoice (or goes on account), raises the customer balance, Premium posts Cash-Bank / AR. Permissions: invoices.view / invoices.manage.

request.description: Invoice paid_total rises; status → partial/paid.

item.name: Customer Deposits
item.description: Advances / store credit. Premium posts Cash-Bank / Customer Deposits (liability 2200). Refund returns the unused amount. Permissions: invoices.view / invoices.manage.

request.description: Customer balance +25 (store credit). Stores {{deposit_id}}.
Refunds the unused amount, reverses balance + posting.

item.name: Supplier Bills
item.description: Accounts payable documents. Standalone bills (services) post General Expense / AP on Premium; purchase-linked bills are auto-created by partially-paid purchases and never double-post. Permissions: bills.view / bills.manage.

request.description: Stores {{bill_id}}.

item.name: Supplier Payments
item.description: Money out to suppliers. Settles a bill (or on account); Premium posts AP / Cash-or-Bank. Permissions: bills.view / bills.manage.

request.description: Bill paid_total 100 of 150 → status partial.

item.name: Reports (Premium)
item.description: Advanced reports — behind plan:premium + reports.advanced. Basic-plan tenants get 403 PLAN_UPGRADE_REQUIRED here.

request.description: Totals, gross profit, daily curve, top products.
Stock value by category + low-stock items.

item.name: Accounting — Chart of Accounts
item.description: Premium. Permission: accounting.view. Balances are computed live from journal_entry_lines on the account's normal-balance side.

item.name: Accounting — Journal Entries
item.description: Premium. accounting.view to read, accounting.manage to create manual entries. Every operational document (sale, purchase, bill, receipt, deposit…) traces here via source_type/source_id.

item.name: Accounting — Financial Periods
item.description: Premium. accounting.view to list; periods.manage (Owner only) to create/close/reopen. A closed period rejects ALL postings dated inside it. NOTE: period ranges are unique — a second collection run will get PERIOD_OVERLAP on create, which is correct behavior.

request.description: Stores {{period_id}}.

item.name: Accounting — Bank Accounts
item.description: Premium. banking.view / banking.manage. Each bank account auto-creates its own GL account (1011, 1012, …); its balance is always derived from the journal. Opening balance posts Bank / Owner's Capital.

request.description: Stores {{bank_account_id}}. Balance starts at 1000 via an opening journal entry.
On-account receipt hitting the bank's GL — balance becomes 1005 on the next list call.

item.name: Accounting — Budget vs Actual
item.description: Premium. budgets.view / budgets.manage (Owner). Budgets plan amounts per GL account for a date range; the show endpoint IS the budget-vs-actual report (budgeted, actual from the journal, variance, used %).

request.description: Stores {{budget_id}}.

item.name: Access Control (401 / 403)
item.description: Proves the three protection layers: missing token (401), missing permission (403 FORBIDDEN, e.g. Cashier writing finance documents), and plan gating (403 PLAN_UPGRADE_REQUIRED for Basic-plan tenants on premium routes — the demo tenant is premium, so that case needs a basic tenant to reproduce). NOTE: staff user management endpoints are not part of the API yet; roles/permissions are seeded per tenant.

request.description: Cashier HAS products.view.
Cashier HAS invoices.view (counter lookups).

item.name: Cleanup
item.description: Removes the throw-away product so repeat runs stay tidy. (Documents like sales/invoices are intentionally kept — they are history.)

request.description: Soft delete. Requires products.delete.

item.name: System Health
item.description: Sanity check that the app responds at all — no auth involved.
